vocabulary.example: The domestication of dogs from wolves is believed to have occurred thousands of years ago.

vocabulary.definition: the artificial application of water to land or crops to assist in the growth of plants
vocabulary.example: The ancient civilizations developed advanced irrigation systems to maximize crop production.

vocabulary.definition: to preserve a body by embalming and drying to prevent decay
vocabulary.example: The ancient Egyptians were known for their elaborate process of mummifying their pharaohs.

vocabulary.definition: a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet at the top
vocabulary.example: The pyramids of Giza in Egypt are some of the most famous ancient pyramids in the world.
